headline.zh: 街头文化与精品咖啡的完美结合
headline.en: Streetwear and specialty coffee in harmony

traits.zh: 木质墙面配黑色金属层架，陈列黑胶唱片
traits.en: Wooden walls with black metal shelves, vinyl records on display

traits.zh: 临街落地玻璃窗，窗外绿树、街道与车辆
traits.en: Street-facing glass windows, green trees and vehicles outside

traits.zh: 靠窗设长条木吧台，配4张黑色金属高脚凳
traits.en: Long wooden bar by the window, 4 black metal stools

traits.zh: 每一杯咖啡来自自家烘焙的亚非拉优质豆
traits.en: Coffee from self-roasted beans, sourced from Asia, Africa, Latin America
